page.overview:
Who is Stanley's Family?

Stanley's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Stanley from Room for One More, the second story of Fazbear Frights 3: 1:35AM.

Stanley is the main protagonist of the third Fazbear Frights book's second story.

Main article: MelissaMelissa is Stanley's older sister. When Stanley's reports feeling sick, she comes over to his apartment to help him. She helps Stanley eat food and cleans his apartment.

Stanley's unnamed granny is mentioned a few times due to her strange sayings. When reflecting on his job interview Stanley comments that companies wanted to make sure they "weren't hiring the fox to guard the henhouse," which his granny used to say. Later, when Melissa is cleaning up Stanley's apartment she says he "look like a Death holding a cracker," a saying from their Granny that their never understood.
